hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q -- '--no-verify'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Do not skip pre-commit hooks with --no-verify. Fix the underlying issue instead."}'; exit 2; fi

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '(openmetadata-ui/src/main/resources/ui/src/generated/|ingestion(-core)?/src/metadata/generated/|/target/generated-sources/)'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Blocked write to GENERATED output. This file is produced by code generation (jsonschema2pojo / datamodel-code-generator / quicktype / ANTLR); hand edits are overwritten by the next build and, for the committed UI types, reverted by the typescript-type-generation CI job. Edit the JSON Schema under openmetadata-spec/src/main/resources/json/schema/ and run make generate (a repo-root-only target). See .claude/rules/schema-first.md."}'; exit 2; fi
hooks.description: Block edits to generated output; direct to the schema + make generate

hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE 'docs/generated/(entity-index|api-reference)\.md'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Blocked write to a GENERATED reference doc. docs/generated/entity-index.md and api-reference.md are produced by scripts/generate_entity_index.py and scripts/generate_api_reference.py; hand edits are reverted by the reference-docs freshness CI job. Change the source instead (JSON Schemas under openmetadata-spec/ for the entity index; the JAX-RS *Resource.java classes for the API reference) and run make generate-reference-docs."}'; exit 2; fi
hooks.description: Block edits to generated reference docs; direct to the source + make generate-reference-docs

hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '(^|/)AGENTS\.md$'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Blocked write to AGENTS.md. It is a symlink to CLAUDE.md; edit CLAUDE.md directly and do not replace the symlink with a regular file."}'; exit 2; fi
hooks.description: Block edits to AGENTS.md; it is a symlink to CLAUDE.md

hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '(^|/)\.github/workflows/'; then if [ "${CLAUDE_ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS:-}" = "1" ]; then exit 0; fi; echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Editing .github/workflows/** is not permitted without explicit user authorization — CI workflows are a supply-chain / prompt-injection surface, so the agent must not change them on its own. Ask the user to confirm. To authorize, the user sets CLAUDE_ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=1 in the environment (the agent cannot set this for the hook), or applies the change themselves."}'; exit 2; fi
hooks.description: Block agent edits to .github/workflows/** unless the user set CLAUDE_ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=1

hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); UI=openmetadata-ui/src/main/resources/ui; case "$FILE" in *"$UI"/src/*.ts|*"$UI"/src/*.tsx) REL="${FILE#*$UI/}"; cd "$UI" || exit 0; yarn --silent lint:base "$REL" || exit 2;; esac
hooks.description: Lint a just-written UI file so the agent sees the same eslint errors CI would report, in the same turn
